description: This file defines a static class LogFormatter responsible for formatting log messages, dates, times, and exceptions for logging purposes within the Orleans.Runtime namespace.

classes.name: LogFormatter
classes.description: A static utility class for formatting log messages, dates, times, and exceptions for the Orleans logging system.

methods.name: PrintDate
methods.description: Converts a DateTime object into a string formatted as 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fff GMT' for logging.

methods.name: ParseDate
methods.description: Parses a date string in the specified format back into a DateTime object.

methods.name: PrintTime
methods.description: Converts a DateTime object into a string formatted as 'HH:mm:ss.fff GMT' for logging.

methods.name: PrintException
methods.description: Converts an Exception object into a detailed string, including nested exceptions and stack traces.

methods.name: SetExceptionDecoder
methods.description: Registers a custom decoder function for a specific exception type.
